psychological_meaning: Cognac, a shade reminiscent of aged brandy, evokes feelings of warmth, sophistication, and groundedness. It blends the energy of red with the stability of brown, suggesting reliability and comfort. This color often represents maturity, resilience, and a connection to traditional values. It can also inspire a sense of indulgence and refined taste.
